item.title: At least 19 dead in stampede at Kolkata Hindu festival
item.description: A seven-year-old girl was among at least 19 people killed in a stampede during a Hindu festival in Kolkata, India.

item.title: Tunisia’s economic crisis deepens as the promise of a better life fades
item.description: Joblessness, failing services and rising costs deepen hardship across the country.

item.title: Rubio wants ‘crackdown’ on settler violence after US journalist attack
item.description: Rubio wants ‘crackdown’ on settler violence after US journalist attack

item.title: Search continues for 11 missing after boat sank off Mexico’s Baja coast
item.description: Some of 16 survivors treated for suspected shark bites, US coastguard says.

item.title: Fears grow in DRC as former President Joseph Kabila joins rebellion
item.description: Kabila’s move raises new questions about the war in eastern Congo and prospects for peace.

item.title: Iran says two tankers catch fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The vessels, each carrying about two million barrels of crude oil, used an unauthorised route, the IRGC says.

item.title: Buildings burn as French protests go into the night
item.description: Witnesses say masked protesters set fire to Limoges town hall, which officials say is now ‘largely lost’.

item.title: Saudi-led forces try to break Houthi siege of Taiz with airstrikes
item.description: Saudi-led forces say they’ve struck multiple positions around the Yemeni city of Taiz to break the Houthi siege.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats in the occupied West Bank
item.description: Masked Israeli settlers attacked European diplomats, a French mayor and Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Iran war live: Israeli settlers attack EU diplomats; drones target Riyadh
item.description: Fires reported on three tankers, as masked settlers attack European politicians in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: US ambassador urges Israel to prosecute attackers of American journalist
item.description: US Secretary of State Rubio separately urges Israel to ‘crack down’ on settler violence after attack on photographer.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts drones as Egypt weighs sending help
item.description: Forces intercepted and destroyed four drones over Saudi Arabia's Riyadh, Eastern Province and southern region.

item.title: Photos: No Kings rallies in US urge midterm voters to cast ballots early
item.description: Thousands gathered at events throughout the country on Saturday, building on two years of No Kings marches.

item.title: Cost of living protests hit Belgium, Italy, Portugal and France
item.description: Hundreds of thousands take to the streets for separate demonstrations, putting pressure on governments across the EU.

item.title: Ten killed in fire at beach resort in Bangladesh
item.description: Ten people, including six members of the same family, were killed in a fire at a beach resort in Bangladesh.

item.title: Protesters allege police brutality as violent clashes rage on in Albania
item.description: Protesters in Albania accuse riot police of brutality as clashes turn violent outside the Education Ministry.

item.title: Al Jazeera reporter harassed, struck on head amid France protests, looting
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Rosie Rosie Birchard was harassed by protesters looting shops in Rennes, France.

item.title: Iranian TV airs video said to show tanker explosion in Hormuz
item.description: Iranian state TV aired footage claiming to show an oil tanker exploding after striking a naval mine in Hormuz

item.title: At least 17 killed in stampede at religious gathering in India
item.description: Incident took place at festival in north Kolkata, in India's West Bengal state, amid big crowds and rainfall, police said.

item.title: Albanian police fire rubber bullets as protests against Rama escalate
item.description: Five days of clashes rock Tirana as students join a wider movement demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation.

item.title: Hundreds rally in Kyiv to demand the resignation of Mayor Vitali Klitschko
item.description: Hundreds of protesters rallied outside the office of Kyiv’s mayor Vitali Klitschko, demanding that he steps down.

item.title: Will the EU come to Ukraine’s rescue in war against Russia?
item.description: US support at risk as Trump-Zelenskyy relations nosedive.

item.title: Is the US Embassy in Jerusalem for Israel or America?
item.description: What led to the deaths of the nine Americans killed in the occupied West Bank since 2022?

item.title: Israeli drone attacks kill six Palestinians across Gaza despite ‘ceasefire’
item.description: Attacks hit several areas as UNICEF reports more than 340 children killed since 'ceasefire' began a year ago.

item.title: India and West Indies denied a thrilling finale as rain hits final T20
item.description: India reached 118-5 after seven overs with Naman Dhir hitting 24 off six balls before rain forced an end to the game.
